## Data checklist

Skip for code-only changes. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/GooeyAI/ecocost/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Every changed value deep-links to the page, table or section that holds it
- [ ] The tier matches the evidence (tier 1 only for the primary source's own published figure)
- [ ] Ranges are honest; `min`/`max` left out when only a point value is known
- [ ] `note` says what the number is: period, scope, measured or target, any unit conversion
- [ ] Grid figures are location-based, not market-based
- [ ] Any new source is registered in `ecocost/data/sources.yaml` with its licence (and in `NOTICE` if it requires attribution)
- [ ] `provenance` updated for each changed record
